claim: *Task-driven traversal.* A task enters the modeling substrate through a named system entity and follows only the represented relationships required by its engineering question.

topology.description: Directed task entry to named entity; equal unordered relation peers accessible selectively.

required_terms: Named entity A job or a service
Retrieve only the relations needed for the current question; no prescribed traversal order.
bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Common gray relation peers contrast with task and entity. Selective traversal relations retained without imposing order.

alt: A task enters through a named system entity. Connections fan out to six peer relationships: service registry, flow model, lifecycle, policy, provenance and measurements. The task retrieves only relationships needed for its question. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
